title: Eli Lilly and the LA Dodgers: A tale of 2 dynasties
snippet: Watching the baseball playoffs this week, I was struck by the parallels between the Los Angeles Dodgers and Eli Lilly. Both franchises spend a lot of money and always appear to come out on top.

title: Survival Outcomes in Metaplastic Versus Triple-Negative Invasive Breast Carcinoma: A Propensity Score-Matched Study.
snippet: : Metaplastic breast carcinoma (MBC) is a rare, predominantly triple-negative breast cancer subtype with aggressive clinical behaviour.
